agents.note: US-413 DONE (passes:true, committed 31a9ee9). drive_counter server-side sync gap (F-064) closed. ROOT CAUSE: drive_counter is a single-row state mirror, not a delta table, so it rides SyncClient.pushDriveCounter() (US-314, already built+tested) -- but that push was wired ONLY into forcePush() (the power-down flush). The periodic ticks _maybeTriggerIntervalSync + triggerDriveEndSync call pushAllDeltas() only, which skips the singleton, so the server last_drive_id advanced only on a clean shutdown; an unclean power cycle stranded it (Pi 10, server 3). Server upsert is monotonic GREATEST()/MAX() -> re-sync never regresses (acceptance #2 idempotency).
